skill.name: canva-automation
skill.description: Automates Canva design discovery, creation, uploads, exports, folders, and brand template autofill through Rube MCP.
skill.summary: Run common Canva workflows through Rube MCP with schema-aware tool selection.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Reviewed SKILL.md and found no prompt injection, malware intent, or executable shell code. The external command detections are Markdown inline code and fenced examples, not code execution. The only confirmed issue is a low-risk external MCP endpoint for Rube.

remediation.issue: Third-party MCP endpoint requires user trust.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users to verify the Rube MCP endpoint and review Canva OAuth permissions before connecting an account.

remediation.issue: Markdown backticks create high static-analysis noise.
remediation.suggestion: Consider plain text tool names or a short note that examples are documentation, not shell commands.

static_findings.snippet: - Active Canva connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `canva`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
1. `CANVA_LIST_USER_DESIGNS` - List all designs with optional filters [Required]
- `query`: Search term to filter designs by name
- Results are paginated; follow `continuation` token until absent
- `asset_id`: Optional asset to include in the design
- `url`: Public URL of the file to upload (for URL-based uploads)
- `job_id`: Upload job ID returned from step 1 (for status polling)
- The `job_id` from CREATE returns the ID needed for status polling
3. `CANVA_GET_DESIGN_EXPORT_JOB_RESULT` - Poll until export completes and get download URL [Required
- `design_id`: ID of the design to export
- `job_id`: Export job ID for polling status
- `item_id`: ID of the design or asset to move
- `brand_template_id`: ID of the brand template to use
- `data`: Key-value mapping of placeholder names to replacement values
- Pass token in next request's `continuation` parameter
- Continue until `continuation` is absent or empty
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Initiate job (upload, export, autofill) -> get job_id
2. Poll status endpoint with job_id every 2-3 seconds
- Upload job must reach 'success' status before the asset_id is valid
| Move to folder | CANVA_MOVE_ITEM_TO_SPECIFIED_FOLDER | item_id, folder_id |
- File size limits apply; large files may take longer to process

content.user_title: Automate Canva Designs with Rube MCP
content.value_statement: Teams lose time repeating Canva exports, uploads, and folder updates. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Rube MCP workflows.
actual_capabilities: Searches Rube MCP for current Canva tool schemas before use.
Lists and searches Canva designs with pagination and ownership filters.
Creates Canva designs from scratch or with an uploaded asset.
Uploads assets and polls job status until completion.
Exports designs and retrieves temporary download links.
Organizes designs with folders and brand template autofill.
limitations: Requires Rube MCP and an active Canva OAuth connection.
Does not edit individual canvas elements beyond supported Canva tool actions.
Async operations require polling and may be delayed by Canva rate limits.
Upload and export formats depend on current Canva API limits.

use_cases.title: Prepare campaign assets
use_cases.description: Find existing Canva designs, upload approved assets, and export final campaign files.

use_cases.title: Organize shared libraries
use_cases.description: Create folders and move designs so teams can find reusable brand materials.

use_cases.title: Generate template variants
use_cases.description: Use brand template autofill to create localized or personalized design versions.

prompt_templates.title: Find a design
prompt_templates.prompt: Search my Canva designs for [design name] and summarize the closest matches.

prompt_templates.title: Export a file
prompt_templates.prompt: Find my design named [name], export it as [format], and tell me when the download link is ready.

prompt_templates.title: Upload and create
prompt_templates.prompt: Upload the asset at [public URL], create a [design type] titled [title], and confirm the asset was attached.

prompt_templates.title: Autofill a campaign set
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the brand template [template name] to create designs from these placeholder values: [campaign data]. Poll until completion.

output_examples.input: Export the quarterly review deck as a PDF.
output_examples.output: The matching design was found, the export job completed, and a temporary PDF download link is ready.

output_examples.input: Create a folder for launch assets and move the poster design into it.
output_examples.output: A launch assets folder was created, and the poster design was moved into that folder.

output_examples.input: Create regional social posts from the spring campaign brand template.
output_examples.output: The brand template was selected, regional values were applied, and the generated designs are ready for review.

best_practices: Run the Rube tool search before each workflow so schemas match current Canva tools.
Confirm design, folder, and template names before changing Canva content.
Poll async jobs until success or failure, then report clear status to the user.
anti_patterns: Do not assume a design ID from a name without listing and confirming matches.
Do not reuse expired export links in later workflows.
Do not upload private assets from inaccessible local paths or untrusted public URLs.

faq.question: Does this skill need a Canva account?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires an active Canva OAuth connection through Rube MCP.

faq.question: Can it create new Canva designs?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create supported design types, with or without an uploaded asset.

faq.question: Can it export existing designs?
faq.answer: Yes. It can start export jobs and retrieve temporary download links after completion.

faq.question: Does it support brand templates?
faq.answer: Yes. It can list brand templates and start autofill jobs with placeholder values.

faq.question: Can it organize folders?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create folders and move Canva items into selected folders.

faq.question: Why does it search tools first?
faq.answer: Rube tool schemas may change. Searching first helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code call current parameters.
